outcomes.text: Describe Earth’s processes & patterns and how landscapes have changed over time. (structure and formation of the earth)
Use map conventions in different types of maps to gather information about landforms, relief, and resources.
Use coordinates to read 6 figure grid references to locate places on a map.
Gather information using maps and globes to inquire about geographical changes of a selected region or a landform.
Recall the differences between weather and climate.
Study some of the elements of weather.
Study the distribution of climate in the world.
Investigate how climate is important for different vegetation.
Investigate how and why our climate is changing. (deforestation)
Recall economic activities related to natural, capital, and human resources. (forestry, education, and industrialization)
Explore the ways in which forests of the world and forests of Pakistan contribute to the economy of the region they belong to.
Inquire why landforms are changing due to human activity (Agriculture). (Note: This varies according to provinces)
Study reasons for selecting a place to develop settlements. (economic activity, jobs & transport)
Compare settlements to understand adaptation according to human needs.

Use a range of multiple sources such as conventional maps, Google Maps, satellite images, photographs, diagrams, GPS, GIS, newspaper articles, thematic maps, and field trips to derive information of physical, human and environmental geography of Pakistan and of the world to reach and support conclusions.
Analyze how the scarcity of resources compels people to use resources wisely.
Analyze how the interdependence of resources within the global economy.
Discover differences in lifestyles of two different settlements to appreciate and respect diversity.

topics.title: Role of Science and Technology in Economy

subtopics.title: Role of Science and Technology in Economy

outcomes.text: Understand that advancements in science and technology influence the economic progress of a region.
Inquire about the relationship between physical & human geography.
Understand and describe the effects of the physical environment on humans. (adaptation & lifestyle)
Understand and describe the effects of human activities on the physical environment. (urbanization, industrialization)
Find ways to improve the quality of their own and global environment. (deforestation, global warming)
Understand that exports generate revenue for a country which is necessary for a country to operate and progress.
Inquire about Earth's processes & patterns and how landscapes have changed over time. (weather & climate, natural vegetation)
Use map conventions to understand time zones and datelines.
Gather information using maps, globes, photographs, aerial photographs, satellite images and graphs to inquire about geographical changes of a selected region or a landform.
Investigate how and why our climate is changing. (excessive agriculture)
Describe economic activities related to natural, capital, and human resources. (agriculture, land supply, and population)
Suggest ways to utilize resources and conserve them.
Inquire why landforms are changing due to human activity (high population, scarcity of livable land).
Understand and describe the effects of excess land use (causes and effects of population increase, excessive agriculture, and excessive urbanization). (Note: This varies according to provinces)
Study reasons for selecting a place to develop settlements. (economic activity, jobs & transport)
Compare urban and rural infrastructure to understand adaptation according to human needs.

Use a range of multiple sources as conventional maps, Google maps, satellite images, photographs, diagrams, GPS, GIS, newspaper articles, thematic maps, and field trips to derive information of the physical, human, and environmental geography of Pakistan and of the world to develop and support conclusions.
Analyze how the scarcity of resources compels people to wisely use and modify resources.
Understand the basic role of global economic systems and interdependence within the global economy.
Study reasons for selecting a place to develop settlements. (socio-economic status & lifestyle of people in the city)
Develop a sense of respect for diversity and empathy to tolerate differences in near and far settlements.

subtopics.title: Role of Science and Technology in Economy

outcomes.text: Understand that the economic progress of a region relies upon the specialization of resources through education, scientific research, and technology.
Inquire why landforms are changing due to the natural processes of the earth. (causes and consequences)
Inquire why landforms are changing due to human activity. (causes and consequences of pollution)
Find ways to improve the quality of their own and global environment. (deforestation, global warming)
Understand that high revenues can be generated by exporting finished goods as per current demand.
Beginning to understand the basic role of global economic institutions. (World Bank & IMF)

Construct arguments and provide evidence for their understanding of Earth’s processes & patterns and how landscapes are changing constantly. (earthquakes, river systems, water cycle, rock cycle, mineral resources)
Interpret required information using maps, globes, photographs, aerial photographs, satellite images, and graphs to inquire about geographical changes of a selected region or a landform.
Investigate geographical, climatic, political, cultural, and economic aspects of places using geographic representations and geospatial technologies.
Investigate how and why our climate is changing. (soil erosion)
Examine how weather and climate affect the processes of the earth.
Investigate economic activities related to natural, capital, and human resources. (fishery, Mineral & Energy resource)
Find ways to utilize and conserve resources.
Express opinions on why landforms are changing due to human activity.
Understand and describe the effects of excess land use. (Note: This varies according to provinces)
Study reasons for selecting a place to develop settlements. (economic activity, jobs & transport)
Study a selected infrastructure to understand adaptation according to human needs (CPEC).

Use a range of multiple sources such as conventional maps, Google maps, satellite images, photographs, diagrams, GPS, GIS, newspaper articles, geographical journals, thematic maps, and field trips to derive information on the physical, human and environmental geography of Pakistan and of the world to reach and support personal conclusions and critique with credibility.
Demonstrate efficient use of resources in scarcity
Analyse and describe basics of global economic systems and interdependence of resources in a selected region.
Develop a deep sense of empathy for the diverse groups in different settlements.
Discover differences in lifestyles of a selected region to understand that cultures are determined according to place, resources, beliefs, climate, technological development, and human needs.

subtopics.title: Role of Science and Technology in Economy

outcomes.text: Evaluate how the economic progress of a region relies upon the specialization of resources through education, scientific research, and technology.
Inquire about the impact of overusing natural and other resources on the environment.
Identify how places are interdependent on each other and how human activity in one place affects the other. (deforestation, pollution & climate change)
Reflect on their role to improve the quality of their own and global environment. (managing land and water resources)
Analyze that high revenues can be generated by exporting finished goods through technological advancements, marketing trends, and professional ethics.
Describe the basic role of global economic institutions. (World Bank & IMF)
